speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Sarcoidosis with mucocutaneous involvement.

The combination of a new onset cough, recent arthritis management, and a rash on the upper back with mucositis is highly suggestive of sarcoidosis. I need to confirm the specific characteristics of the rash and the nature of your joint pain before finalizing the plan. Could you describe the rash's texture (e.g., scaly, nodular, painful) and specify which joints are affected by the arthritis?
